capability: Refine until fresh readers find nothing
title: Stop when the counter hits zero.

hook.picture: Close on the whale smoothing one kink in a line; as it does, a new kink pops up further along; a pod reads and answers ✕.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: I keep tweaking it, and I never know when to stop.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: learner on their fifth rewrite of one prompt

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Three-times device: three kinks slip past the whale's own glance, every 2 beats, then 1, then ½.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: You can't see your own blind spots.

stakes.body: Endless rewriting by feel: time burned, and the author misses the flaws only a fresh reader would see.

solution_hint: Let fresh eyes list the fixes. Repeat.

metaphor.body: Outline whales are fresh readers who ring each kink they find; a counter shows how many; the whale fixes the list and asks again until the counter reads zero.

steps.picture: Three outline whales swim along the line; each rings every kink it finds; a counter chip shows the count.
Push-in: the whale fixes every ringed kink; the readers swim again and ring fewer; the counter drops.
A last pass: no rings. The counter reads 0 and the line holds still.
steps.words: Nothing left to fix? Stop there.

steps.picture: The still line, counter at 0, whale resting.
steps.words: That still point is a fixpoint.

real_case.claim: Studio meta-prompt RMP ledger: three critics gave 14, 14 and 10 edits (v1 to v3); the author re-check found 0, so v3 is the fixpoint.

honest_limit.picture: The readers are all the same colour. Slow push to a kink on the side none of them faces; it stays unringed. Counter still 0.
honest_limit.words: Same kind of eyes, same blind spot.

not_this.body: Zero fixes found is not the best version.

ending_pattern.body: FELT close shot: the whale lifts a fin to tweak again, sees the counter at 0, and lets go. The line holds; a pod answers ✓.
ending_pattern.callback: In FELT the whale tweaked forever and new kinks kept appearing; the same close shot now shows a counter at 0 and the whale stopping.

end_belief.body: Repeat until fresh eyes find nothing. Then stop.
